subject: Sounds Good to Me
author: Pappy Knuckles
body: I've been dying for some news on another Burnout game and I think your ideas are very good. Paradise was alright, but I long for the closed-track racing of Burnout 3: Takedown and Burnout Revenge. If they implemented your ideas I'd be a happy camper.

subject: your pretty much hit the nail
author: Xedec
body: your pretty much hit the nail right on the head on that one Xandu. I like what you came up with and it sounds perfect!

subject: Like you said above the only
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
Like you said above the only thing that can replace Burnout Revenge ..... is the same game but with more added to it ..... re release the game and then release a DLC content pack .... I know and all burners know that if Criterion did this they would be onto a winner .....

Surely when they designed and developed revenge they didn't just create the tracks that we played, or designed just those cars ? exactly .... so why not implement on what the gamer wants and put money into your companies ass pocket at the same time .....

At the end of the day WE are the gamer WE are the voice ... so why are WE never heard .....
